defect: The All trials walk at 1024 x 768 measured a long title's wrap by row height, which depends on the font: red on GitHub's Linux machine (DejaVu Sans, run 44377053041 on PR 12), green on the Mac

The trial-details walks waited for any main heading after opening a trial, so they read the Needs review heading (Myeloma) still on screen when the trial page drew late: red on GitHub's Linux machine (run 44411871654 on PR 13, also run 44377053041 on PR 12), green on the Mac

The Find trials zero-matches walk read the search summary while it was being redrawn and briefly absent (TypeError reading innerText of null): red under load on GitHub's Linux machine (runs 44411871654 and 44377053041), green alone; not reproduced on the Mac, so its check is the walk itself, now waiting for the summary to exist

The hand-over page missed a program of the project still listening on a port when its command line was long: Linux's ps cut each piped command line at 80 columns, so the file it was started with was lost (red on Linux in a parallel unit run, whose temporary folders have longer paths; green on the Mac)

A proof run stopped at its time limit raised PermissionError instead of reporting it: after the stop, macOS refuses to kill a process group whose members have all exited but are not yet reaped (EPERM), and only ProcessLookupError was caught, so the kill raced the reaping (red once in a parallel unit run after ticket 08, tests/test_prove_runs.py::test_a_run_that_passes_its_time_limit_is_stopped_with_all_it_started_and_the_proof_ends_one)

The trial page drew the review bar's sentence (Review covers all N changes shown above.) and the Changes heading only after the watchlist's queue answered, though neither depends on it, so for that moment the bar showed its buttons with its first line blank; the action-bar walk, which waited for the Mark reviewed button, read the blank line when the queue answered late under load (red beside the other walks, green alone: kit-phase-2 at 1024 x 768, kit-phase-4 at 1440 x 900)

A registry code that is not a bare word could be put into a stored search's filter, where a bracket closes the area clause early and widens the search; the only record of why the code must stay a bare word was a comment the build removed, and loosening the check left every test green (finding review-whole-01)

A forced check that found nothing could store a second copy of the record it re-fetched, growing a snapshot per forced check and moving the stored registry stamp past the change still reported; the only record of why it stores nothing was a comment the build removed, and storing always left every test green (finding review-whole-02)

A new default list made after every list was deleted could take back trials the analyst had dropped with their last list; the only record of why they are left out was a comment the build removed (the docstring read as the opposite), and deleting the filter left every test green (finding review-whole-03)

A trial's history could list an undo below the review it undid when both fall in the same second; the only record of the tie order (the later-made kind leads) was a comment the build removed, and swapping the order left every test green (finding review-whole-04)

A reader who scrolled down a trial's Changes tab, or scrolled and marked reviewed, before the watchlist's queue answered was thrown back to the top when it answered: the trial page waited for the queue before the router moved it to the top, after the page was already on the screen; the same race could turn the action-bar walk red (findings walker-trial-page-01, review-trial-page-01)

With a trial open in two tabs, Mark reviewed in the second tab after the first had reviewed its changes said the changes were marked reviewed and offered an Undo that showed the script error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'id') and undid nothing: the server answers a review of changes already reviewed with no review to undo, and the page built an Undo anyway; when only some were already reviewed, the page counted them all as its own (finding walker-trial-page-02; E-033 closed the double-click way to the same error)

When the watchlist's list of trials to review failed to load, the trial page turned Next trial off with the hover text No other trial needs review, which may be untrue, and said nowhere that the list failed: the page treated a failed answer as an empty list (finding walker-trial-page-03)

On a trial with a single change, the review bar said Review covers all 1 changes shown above. and, once reviewed, These 1 changes are reviewed.; this build's new sentence for changes another tab had already reviewed said These 1 changes were already reviewed.: the sentences put the count before a fixed plural word instead of choosing the word by the count (finding walker-trial-page-recheck-01)
